name: migrate
description: Source-agnostic legacy migration mapping. Enumerates the legacy surface from two independent directions per lens, derives a capability seam empirically, extracts cited functional requirements, plans parity, and routes every ambiguity to a batch decision queue. Coverage arithmetic and citation resolution are enforced by a bundled Bun CLI rather than self-reported. Use when the user asks to migrate, re-specify, or map a legacy system.
author: iceinvein
